description:
Welcome to the next phase of stylish living. Yours, at The Grange.

Exquisitely finished apartments, The Grange is nestled in Stillorgan, a homely south Dublin suburb just 8km from the bustling city centre and 5km from Dundrum Town Centre. With a range of excellent amenities both on-site and in the locality, life at The Grange is peaceful and diverse all at once. Some of the community amenities you can enjoy include premium lounge areas and a games room, an on-site gym with shower facilities, a co-working space for home-based working and much more.

With its convenient location, our residents will stay connected and travel with ease. Situated within a lively retail, leisure and education hub, the following locations and transport links are near-at-hand: Foxrock, Blackrock Village, Dundrum, Stillorgan, Sandyford, the Green LUAS line, and the M50. 

Every detail of our spaces has been carefully curated, boasting impeccable design and only the highest quality finishes. They truly speak to how we live our lives today, whether it's working remotely from our bespoke business centre, kicking back in our recreation room or cooking up a storm in our resident's kitchen. Choose from three premium options, including one-bedroom, two bedroom and studio apartments. With every convenience considered and apartments to suit every lifestyle, all that's missing is you. 

Resident Amenities Include: 

-	Spacious, modern resident amenities area offering best in class:
-	Lounge areas
-	Communal kitchen
-	Games room
-	Business centre
-	Fitness centre, including shower facilities
-	Children's playroom

Our aim? To offer you a stylish living experience in Dublin's fair city, within beautifully finished spaces that have everything you need to enjoy day-to-day life. With open arms, we welcome you to life at The Grange.
